The '''Lab 68''' was located inside the [[Dark Heart]] located in the [[Nightmare Lands]] region on [[Voss]]. In it Sith Lord [[Wratchen]] met with [[Jela Reneke]] before being interrupted and killed by the [[Voidhound]].
